## Prerequisites

- **CUSTOMERS-1-API completed** — this story consumes the existing `GET /customers/:id/notes` and `POST /customers/:id/notes` routes registered in `api/src/features/customers/customers.routes.js:26,35`. No `api/` changes are permitted (out-of-scope per intake).
- **`web/` package only.** Commands run from `web/` with `npm`.
- Coordinate wording with the shared error map so the new domain codes surface through `t.errors[...]`.

---

## Story Goal

Give an agent, from a customer's screen, the ability to **read the customer's internal notes** and **write a new one**, so that:

1. Writing a valid note makes it appear in the list **without reloading the whole screen** (the POST reply is appended to the in-memory list; the GET does not fire a second time).
2. Submitting a blank or whitespace-only note is refused **on the field** with the same wording the API would return — the request is not sent.
3. Every note shows **who wrote it** and **when**, with the timestamp rendered in the reader's locale (BR-3) and the author id resolved to a human-readable label (`author_id === null` reads as "System", not blank) (BR-2).
4. Every visible string comes from `en.ts` and `ar.ts`, added in the same edit so `parity.test.ts` stays green (BR-6).

**Out of scope:** editing/deleting a note, notes on a ticket/conversation, any change under `api/`.

## Product rules (from story)

- **Current behaviour:** there is no customer detail screen; notes are neither readable nor writable from the web.
- **New behaviour:** a customer's detail page lists internal notes newest-first and lets the agent write one; the created note is appended in place; whitespace-only input is refused before the request; every string is translated; the author and time are always visible; system-written notes read as "System" rather than blank.

## Frontend Tasks

### 1 — Route the customer detail page

**File:** `web/src/app/routes.tsx`

Add a route below the existing `/customers` route (currently at line 33): `path="/customers/:id"` that mounts a new `CustomerDetailPage`. Import from `../pages/customers/CustomerDetailPage`. Wrap in the same `RequireAuth` / `DeskShell` composition already used for `/customers`. Keep the existing `/customers` route untouched.

### 2 — Create the notes-list hook

**Create file:** `web/src/pages/customers/useCustomerNotes.ts`

Model on `useCustomerSearch.ts`. Export a `Note` type plus a hook that returns `{ status, notes, error, load, append }`:

- `load(customerId)` → `request(\`/customers/${customerId}/notes\`)`; on success stores `page.items` sorted newest-first (or in the order the API returned).
- `append(note)` → prepends the note the POST returned to the in-memory list. **No re-fetch.**
- Wraps the request in `useRequest` so consumers get the same four-state contract as the rest of the app.

Do **not** call `/api/v1/...` — `request` already prefixes it.

### 3 — Create the write-note hook

**Create file:** `web/src/pages/customers/useWriteCustomerNote.ts`

Model on `web/src/pages/tickets/useAssignTicket.ts`. Export `{ status, error, run }` where `run(customerId, body)`:

1. **Pre-checks `body.trim().length > 0`.** If empty, resolves with `{ ok: false, code: 'BODY_REQUIRED' }` (or the exact code the API uses — confirm via grep against `customers.service.js` / rules) **without calling `request`**. The API's rules layer refuses the same input, so the round-trip is wasted.
2. Otherwise `POST /customers/:id/notes` with `{ body: body.trim() }` and returns the created note from the 201 response.

### 4 — Build the detail page

**Create file:** `web/src/pages/customers/CustomerDetailPage.tsx`

Structure (follow `CustomersPage.tsx` for tone and `TicketQueuePage.tsx` for a list-plus-form layout):

- `useParams<{ id: string }>()` to read the customer id.
- `useTranslation()`, `useFormatters()`.
- `useCustomerNotes()` + `useWriteCustomerNote()`.
- `useEffect` to `load(id)` on mount, mirroring `CustomersPage.tsx`'s first-page pattern (lines 45–50).
- **Header:** `Heading level={2}` reading `t.customers.notes.title`.
- **Write form:** `Stack as="form" onSubmit=...`. Uses `Field` with a render prop wrapping `TextArea` so the field label and inline error come from the same primitive. Bind the field's error state to a local `fieldError` string translated from `t.errors[code]` (never composed from `fields`). Submit button disabled while the write hook's status is `loading` or when `term.trim() === ''` is intentionally allowed to still show the field-level error on submit rather than silently disabling — pick one and comment why. The precedent in `CustomersPage.tsx:79-84` is to disable during `busy`; follow it for the submit action and rely on the pre-check for whitespace.
- **List branches** (four states from `useCustomerNotes`):
  - `loading` → `Skeleton lines={3} height="72px" label={t.states.loading}`.
  - `error` → `ErrorState title={t.customers.notes.errorTitle} body={t.errors[error.code] ?? t.errors.INTERNAL} onRetry={() => load(id)} retryLabel={t.states.retry}`.
  - `success && notes.length === 0` → `EmptyState title={t.customers.notes.emptyTitle} body={t.customers.notes.emptyBody}` (no action button — writing one is the same page).
  - `success && notes.length > 0` → `<ul>` of `<NoteRow>` items.

- **`NoteRow`** (local component): renders
  - `Text` for the body (preserve line breaks via `white-space: pre-wrap` in CSS).
  - `Text variant="muted"` for the meta line: author label + formatted time.
    - **Author label:** if the DTO already includes a resolved name, render it. Otherwise use `t.customers.notes.systemAuthor` (`"System" / "النظام"`) when `author_id === null`, and fall back to a client-side resolver when non-null (mirror CRM-77's assignees pattern; **do not** fetch per row).
    - **Time:** `useFormatters().dateTime(note.created_at)` — never render the raw UTC string (BR-3).

**On successful write:** call `append(createdNote)`, then reset the form's local state. **Do not** call `load(id)` again — a test will count the requests and fail if a second GET fires (this is the "with teeth" criterion).

## Edge Cases & Failure Modes

- **Whitespace-only body.** Trigger: agent types spaces/newlines and presses submit. Expected: request is **not** sent; the field renders the same message the API would have (`t.errors.BODY_REQUIRED` or the canonical code). Enforced in the pre-check in `useWriteCustomerNote.ts` (task 3) and doubled by the API's rules layer.
- **Duplicate submits.** Trigger: agent clicks Submit twice. Expected: the submit button is `disabled` while the mutation hook status is `loading`, matching `CustomersPage.tsx:79-84`. Confirmed by the same test that counts POSTs.
- **Successful write.** Expected: only **one** POST fires and **no second GET**. Enforced by `append(createdNote)` in the write handler (task 4).
- **`author_id === null`.** Expected: the row reads `t.customers.notes.systemAuthor`, never a blank. Enforced in `NoteRow`.
- **Non-null `author_id` with no name in the DTO.** Expected: resolve on the client (CRM-77 pattern), not one fetch per row. **Uncertainty:** confirm whether the API DTO already carries an author display name by grepping `customers.service.js` for `author` and `name`. If it does, use it directly; if not, add a single lookup (batched or from the assignees list). Document what you found in the PR description.
- **Unicode / RTL content.** Trigger: an agent writes an Arabic note. Expected: the body renders correctly in an RTL paragraph. Follow the `Isolated` pattern from `CustomersPage.tsx:29,32` if the meta line mixes LTR ids with RTL text.
- **API error on load.** Trigger: server returns 500. Expected: the error branch shows `t.errors[error.code] ?? t.errors.INTERNAL` with a Retry button that calls `load(id)` again.
- **Unknown / new error code from the API.** Expected: falls back to `t.errors.INTERNAL`. Never derive a sentence from `error.fields`.
- **Timestamp rendering.** Trigger: reader switches language. Expected: `useFormatters().dateTime` re-renders in the new locale. Enforced in `NoteRow`.
- **Concurrent notes.** Trigger: another agent writes a note between load and write. Expected: the appended list may not include the other agent's note until the page is reopened; acceptable — no polling is in scope.

## Test Plan

Use `vitest` + Testing Library, `render` from `web/src/testing/render.tsx`. Follow patterns in `web/src/pages/tickets/AssignTicket.test.tsx` and `web/src/pages/customers/CustomersPage.test.tsx`. **Every fetch stub returns a fresh `Response` per call** (L-30).

1. **`web/src/pages/customers/CustomerDetailPage.test.tsx`** (new):
   1. Renders the loading skeleton, then the list of notes returned by `GET /customers/:id/notes`, showing author and locale-formatted time for each row.
   2. Whitespace-only input on submit shows the field-level error and **does not** call `fetch` for the POST (assert `mockFetch` was only called for the initial GET).
   3. A valid submit calls `POST /customers/:id/notes` **once**, prepends the returned note to the list, and clears the textarea. **Asserts exactly one GET total** (no re-fetch after the write) — this is the "with teeth" criterion.
   4. When the POST responds with a domain error (e.g. `BODY_REQUIRED`, `CUSTOMER_NOT_FOUND`), the field shows the mapped `t.errors[code]` copy, not a raw code, and no note is appended.
   5. When `author_id === null` on a returned note, the meta line reads the `systemAuthor` translation, not an empty span.
   6. Language switch re-renders the timestamp using the new locale's formatter (small assertion via `useFormatters`).
2. **`web/src/pages/customers/useWriteCustomerNote.test.ts`** (new): unit-tests the pre-check (whitespace returns the domain error without calling `request`) and the trimming behaviour.
3. **`web/src/pages/customers/useCustomerNotes.test.ts`** (new): unit-tests `load` state transitions and `append` prepending semantics without side effects.
4. **`web/src/shared/i18n/parity.test.ts`** — must continue to pass after adding keys in both `en.ts` and `ar.ts`.
5. **`web/src/pages/no-hardcoded-strings.test.ts`** — must continue to pass. Watch separators between JSX tags in `NoteRow`.
6. **`web/src/app/routing.test.tsx`** — extend to cover the `/customers/:id` route mounting `CustomerDetailPage`.

## Verification Steps

1. **Frontend tests:** `cd web && npm test` — the new suites and `parity.test.ts` / `no-hardcoded-strings.test.ts` all pass.
2. **Frontend build:** `cd web && npm run build` (`tsc -b && vite build`) — succeeds. The web suite does not typecheck under `npm test`, so this step is the one that catches TS regressions.
3. **Backend regression (should be a no-op):** `cd api && npm test` — passes unchanged; confirms no `api/` file was touched.
4. **No AI attribution regression:** `grep -Ri --exclude-dir=node_modules -e 'copilot' -e 'chatgpt' -e 'claude' -e 'openai' -e 'anthropic' web/ api/` returns nothing new. Also run `cd api && npm test -- no-ai-attribution` if the test runs from that suite.
5. **Regression: request prefix.** Grep the new files for `/api/v1` — must return zero matches. `request()` already prefixes it.
6. **Regression: fresh Response per stub.** Grep the new test files for `mockFetch.mockResolvedValue(` (single value) — every fetch stub must use `mockResolvedValueOnce` or a factory that builds a new `Response` each call (L-30).
7. **Manual smoke:** `cd web && npm run dev`, sign in, navigate to `/customers/<id>` for a seeded customer, write a note in English and Arabic, verify the note appears without the list flickering, verify blank submit shows the field error, verify system-authored notes read "System" / "النظام".
